entries.1bfe885f37220546: The company operates restaurants including "Osaka Ohsho" (2 stores), a dumpling restaurant; "Nagoya Meshi Shokudo Maruhachi" (2 stores), a specialist in Nagoya meshi; and "Unashō" (1 store), a hitsumabushi restaurant; as well as 4 stores at service areas and parking areas.
entries.212bfaf8a914efbb: A holding company headquartered in Nagoya, centered on a food service business operating izakaya, cafes and restaurants in multiple formats, which also leases and manages real estate.
entries.74fe7a41872d2667: The company operates izakaya with distinct themes, including "Imozō" (11 stores), themed on Kyushu and Kagoshima; "Hakata Kawaya" (11 stores), serving tori-kawa, a Hakata specialty; "Ginjō Maguro" (6 stores), where customers can compare sake; "Hokkori" (5 stores), recreating Kyoto machiya townhouses; and "Kibakumon" (4 stores), serving Hakata cuisine. There are 52 other izakaya stores.
entries.b8e2e17312e17f64: Engages in leasing and management of real estate, including tenant buildings and employee dormitories. The company is also involved in promoting project-based store openings associated with the restaurant business, which consolidated subsidiaries such as Jei Asetto Co., Ltd. undertake. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥1,506 million.
entries.da9a185733c9fc92: Engages in wholesale of food and other products. Consolidated subsidiaries Jei Fīrudo Co., Ltd., Bokadirekushon Co., Ltd. and Mauntenkōhī Co., Ltd. are responsible, and revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥202 million.
entries.ef4bea1f8b3977a5: The company operates "Saru Cafe" (2 stores), which pursues a comfortable atmosphere; "Mou Mou Cafe" (1 store), featuring cream; "egg baby café" (1 store), specializing in egg dishes; and "CAZAN" (4 stores), serving coffee and light meals.
